Furnace Fabrica India Ltd.desc: An Indian engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contractor with its registered office in Kochi, Kerala and works sites at Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra. It reported turnover of Rs 235.96 crore in the financial year 2020-21; the NCLT Kochi bench admitted a State Bank of India insolvency petition against it on 1 November 2023 over a default of Rs 64.74 crore, and by March 2024 its resolution professional described the business as non-operational for the past two years.

Furnace Fabrica India Ltd.note: Checked. The EOI states "Since it is an EPC Company", the registered office "Opposite MILMA Dairy, Koonamthai, Edapally, Kochi, Kerala-682024", Navi Mumbai works addresses, "As per Audited Financial Statement for FY 2020-21 there was a turnover of Rs. 235.96 crores" (the year is the document's own, not inferred from its date) and "business is nonoperational for last 2 years". The NCLT Kochi order of 1 November 2023 gives the admission and "Rs. 64,74,11,693/-" as on 15.05.2023. Checker change: the writer's "operating from Navi Mumbai" is narrowed to works sites there, because the EOI also lists a works site at Kandla SEZ (marked "Under Dispute"). No incorporation year or state is claimed, although the CIN U28123KL1985PLC026752 would imply Kerala 1985 - that restraint is correct and held. No listing is claimed. The Court Kutchehry page carries the operative order text but is partly paywalled; the quoted passages were read directly.

Italian-Thai Development Public Company.desc: A construction company in Thailand, described by The Nation as the country's largest construction company, and listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand under the ticker ITD. Its revenue from construction contracts was 56.93 billion baht in 2023, a year in which it reported a loss of 1.07 billion baht.

sources.title: ITD reports billion baht loss but is confident it can make a comeback
ITD Reports 60% Decline in Profit as Costs and Allowance for Impairment Loss Increase

Italian-Thai Development Public Company.note: Checked. The Nation states "Thailand's largest construction company", "ITD reported revenue from construction contracts in 2023 as 56.93 billion baht" and a "loss of 1.07 billion baht" for that year; it does not state a headquarters or a listing, only that ITD "submitted its 2023 financial statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET)". Kaohoon International names the company in running text as "Italian-Thai Development Public Company Limited (SET: ITD)" and reports it announcing results through the SET; that is a stated exchange and ticker in body text, not logo alt text, so the listing is kept. Checker changes: "Thai construction contractor" is replaced with "a construction company in Thailand", since neither page states nationality or incorporation and "Public Company Limited" in the name is not a source for a Thai listing; "net loss" is reduced to "loss", the word The Nation uses. No founding year, headquarters city, project list or country count is claimed. Kaohoon's figures are 1Q24 and are not used.

MIN Holding (Masinska industrija Nis).note: Blanked by the checker. The two sources the writer used support only the legal name "Doo Masinska industrija Nis Holding", "u stecaju od 2015. godine" (in bankruptcy since 2015) and the bankruptcy estate's sales of buildings in the MIN complex in Nis (Danas, February 2020; Kurir, May 2024). Neither says what the works made, how large it was, or who owns it - the writer's own note says so. That leaves the writer's opening claim, "A machine-industry enterprise", resting only on the words "Masinska industrija" inside the company's own registered name, which is a restatement of the name rather than a source describing the business; and the rest of the proposed desc (limited liability company, bankrupt 2015) only repeats what the case card already states. Under COMP.md a blank is the right outcome. Tried: the company's registered name in Serbian and Latin spellings, the Serbian business register, the Nis city site, Danas, Kurir and the Privatisation Agency notices; the only account of the wider MIN group's products was Wikipedia, barred as a sole source. Not used, and confirmed absent from the above: two Serbian Privatisation Agency notices for differently named Nis entities, "MIN HOLDING CO ... IZGRADNJA AD" and "MIN HOLDING-CO ... MINKOMERC AD", joint-stock companies in bankruptcy from 2011 under Commercial Court Nis cases 2.St.91/2011 and 1.St.73/2011, which are not the limited-liability company this key names.

Metro Linea 1 S.A.S (ML1).desc: A concession company in Colombia, formed by the consortium that won the tender for the first Bogota metro line to carry out concession contract 163 of 2019 with the city company Empresa Metro de Bogota, signed on 27 November 2019. Bogota's own documents give its shareholders as China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (85%) and Xi'an Rail Transportation Group Company Limited, formerly Xi'an Metro Company Limited (15%).

sources.title: Los recursos de la Linea 1 estan en auditoria constante: Concesionario Metro Linea 1
ABC del concesionario de la Primera Linea del Metro de Bogota

Metro Linea 1 S.A.S (ML1).note: Checked, and the writer's framing of the shareholder name is corrected. The 2023 bogota.gov.co page states "China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (85%) y XI'AN Rail Transportation Group Company Limited (15%)" and links the company to "Contrato de Concesion No. 163 de 2019"; the Empresa Metro de Bogota ABC sheet gives the same 85/15 split but names the minority holder "Xi'An Metro Company Limited". The writer treated these as an unreconciled disagreement. They are reconciled in a document the writer itself cited: the Empresa Metro de Bogota Informe de gestion 2019 states "La sociedad Metro Linea 1 S.A.S., conformada por las empresas China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (Chec) y Xi'An Metro Company Limited (hoy, Xi'An Rail Transportation Group Company Limited)" - i.e. the same shareholder under a former and a current name. Both names are therefore printed, with the renaming as the city states it. The same report gives "suscrito posteriormente el 27 de noviembre de 2019" and "empresa concesionaria constituida por el APCA ganadora para la ejecucion del contrato". Checker cuts: the contract's 7.6-year construction and 20-year operation terms and the estimated investment of 13.83 trillion pesos are removed - the ABC sheet gives them as the project's budget and schedule, not as the company's own size, and quoting them would attach a project figure to the company and restate its role in the case. No headquarters, registration date or "special purpose vehicle" wording is claimed; no source opened states any.

Ramky Infrastructure Ltd.desc: An Indian construction and infrastructure company incorporated in 1994 and based in Hyderabad, Telangana, listed on both BSE and the National Stock Exchange of India. It does engineering, procurement, construction and operations and maintenance work in the buildings, industrial, and water and waste water sectors, and reported 1,041 permanent employees for the 2025-26 financial year.

sources.title: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report FY 2025-26, Ramky Infrastructure Limited (scrip 533262)
sources.publisher: National Stock Exchange of India (company filing)

Ramky Infrastructure Ltd.note: Checked. The BRSR states "Year of incorporation 1994", CIN L74210TG1994PLC017356, the Gachibowli, Hyderabad address, listing on "BSE Limited (BSE), National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE)", "Sectors of Buildings, Industrial, Water and Waste Water" with construction at 100% of turnover (NIC 42101, 42203, 42204, 42205), and two business segments, EPC and developer. Checker change: the writer wrote "1,041 permanent employees at the end of the 2025-26 financial year"; the document describes the same figure two ways - the Item 20 table is headed "Details as at the end of Financial Year" and the turnover-rate note says "The average number of total permanent employees during FY 2025-26 was 1,041" - and the Item 20 table is partly illegible in the filing, so the date is softened to "for the 2025-26 financial year". Confirmed that no turnover figure was carried into the desc: the BRSR gives Rs 1,969.36 crore in the CSR item and Rs 1,678.93 crore in the Principle 6 energy note for the same year without reconciling them, so neither is usable.

Simplex Infrastructures Ltd.desc: An Indian engineering and construction company based in Kolkata, listed on BSE and the National Stock Exchange of India, which describes itself as a diversified engineering and construction enterprise with a legacy dating back to 1924. Standalone revenue from operations was 6,702 million rupees in the year to 31 March 2026, with 561 permanent employees on that date; it signed a master restructuring agreement with the National Asset Reconstruction Company on 15 January 2025 covering 99.55% of its secured debt.

sources.title: Annual Report 2025-26, Simplex Infrastructures Limited
sources.publisher: National Stock Exchange of India (company filing)

Simplex Infrastructures Ltd.note: Checked and kept, with the debt figure made specific. The annual report gives the registered office as "'Simplex House' 27, Shakespeare Sarani, Kolkata - 700 017"; the secretarial audit states the shares are listed on "BSE Limited and NSE Limited", with an application for 20,38,052 shares still pending with the Calcutta Stock Exchange (not claimed as a listing); the MD&A states "The company operates as a diversified engineering and construction enterprise" and "With a legacy dating back to 1924"; standalone revenue from operations Rs 6,702 mns (consolidated Rs 10,212 mns, not quoted, to keep the figure on the listed entity); "561 as on 31.03.2026"; and the MRA "executed between the Company and the National Asset Reconstruction Company Limited (NARCL) on January 15, 2025". On the 99.55%, the Board's Report puts it on "secured debt" and the Chairman's message on "outstanding debt exposure as on March 31, 2026"; the narrower of the two bases is used. The report also records that no application has been admitted by the NCLT and no CIRP was pending as at 31 March 2026.
